content: Let Q be the foot of the perpendicular from the point P(7, $$-$$2, 13) on the plane containing the lines $${{x + 1} \over 6} = {{y - 1} \over 7} = {{z - 3} \over 8}$$ and $${{x - 1} \over 3} = {{y - 2} \over 5} = {{z - 3} \over 7}$$. Then (PQ)<sup>2</sup>, is equal to ___________.
